# RNGNeeds

> RNGNeeds is a probability distribution plugin for Unity. It lets developers design and manage weighted probability lists for any type directly in the Unity Inspector, with a full C# API for runtime control. Features include visual probability editing (the Stripe), multiple selection methods (burst-compiled), probability influence providers, depletable lists, repeat prevention, pick history, seeding, and nested list support.

- [Documentation entrypoint](https://docs.rngneeds.com/user-guide/introduction): Recommended starting page for agents and readers
- [Agent skill page](https://docs.rngneeds.com/user-guide/ai-agents): How AI coding agents should learn RNGNeeds concepts and terminology
- [Full documentation as single file](https://docs.rngneeds.com/llms-full.txt): Complete docs in one markdown file for LLM ingestion
- [AI discovery manifest](https://docs.rngneeds.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): Lightweight machine-readable discovery file for agent tooling

## Documentation

- [Overview](https://docs.rngneeds.com/documentation/docs-overview): Map of the documentation sections and how they connect
- [Terminology](https://docs.rngneeds.com/documentation/terminology): Key terms — Probability List, Probability Item, Base/Evaluated Probability, Influence, Weights, etc.
- [Designing a List](https://docs.rngneeds.com/documentation/designing-a-list): Creating lists, adding items, setting probabilities, using weights
- [Selecting Values](https://docs.rngneeds.com/documentation/selecting-values): Pick methods, pick counts, fixed vs random range, selection methods
- [Depletable Lists](https://docs.rngneeds.com/documentation/depletable-lists): Unit-based depletion — items are removed after N picks
- [Repeat Prevention](https://docs.rngneeds.com/documentation/repeat-prevention): Techniques to avoid consecutive duplicate picks
- [Probability Influence](https://docs.rngneeds.com/documentation/probability-influence): Dynamic probability modification via IProbabilityInfluenceProvider
- [Testing Outcomes](https://docs.rngneeds.com/documentation/testing-outcomes): In-editor testing tools for evaluating probability distributions
- [Seeding Options](https://docs.rngneeds.com/documentation/seeding-options): Deterministic seeding, custom seed providers, retained seeds
- [Pick History](https://docs.rngneeds.com/documentation/pick-history): Tracking previous picks per list
- [Nesting Lists](https://docs.rngneeds.com/documentation/nesting-lists): Using probability lists inside other probability lists
- [Customizing Lists](https://docs.rngneeds.com/documentation/customizing-lists): Color themes, dimming, appearance options per drawer
- [Change Log](https://docs.rngneeds.com/documentation/change-log): Version history and release notes

- [Selecting Distinct Values](https://docs.rngneeds.com/guides/guide-selecting-distinct-values): Picking unique items without repeats in a single selection

## API Reference

- [API Overview](https://docs.rngneeds.com/api-reference/api-overview): Map of runtime types and extension points
- [RNGNeeds Core](https://docs.rngneeds.com/api-reference/rngneeds): Static registry, selection method registration, global configuration
- [ProbabilityList<T>](https://docs.rngneeds.com/api-reference/probability-list): The main list type — items, probabilities, picking, seeding, depletion, history
- [ProbabilityItem<T>](https://docs.rngneeds.com/api-reference/probability-item): Per-item properties — enabled, locked, influence, weights, units, depletion
- [PickHistory](https://docs.rngneeds.com/api-reference/pick-history): Recent pick tracking and history inspection
- [Selection Methods](https://docs.rngneeds.com/api-reference/selection-methods): Built-in and custom selection algorithms, burst-compiled variants
- [Seed Providers](https://docs.rngneeds.com/api-reference/seed-provider): ISeedProvider interface and custom seed implementations
- [PLCollection](https://docs.rngneeds.com/api-reference/pl-collection): Named/indexed groups of probability lists for organized multi-list setups
